description: Fork of exp750 (4K SOTA 1.3863). Single change: pass initial_weights_noise=0.0 to out_proj, residual_lut, and emb_resid_lut LUT factories (qk_lut and v_lut keep the default 0.001 init). Zero-init residual contributions so the model starts as identity (x_lut = embedding, x_resid = 0, logits = 0, loss = ln(V)). Mirrors vanilla nano-GPT's zero-init on residual output projections. Compare to exp750 = 1.3863.
